name: edgeblog
description: 在 Cloudflare Workers 上運行的部落格、留言板與檔案下載網站

scripts.files:local: wrangler r2 object put edgeblog-files/guide.md --file=files/guide.md --local && wrangler r2 object put edgeblog-files/cloudflare-checklist.md --file=files/cloudflare-checklist.md --local && wrangler r2 object put edgeblog-files/sample-data.csv --file=files/sample-data.csv --local
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:local && npm run seed:local && npm run files:local
